candidate_evidence.quote: [OTHER] Standard Treatment Plus Metabolic Therapy Program: See description under "Arms."

Two 5-day fasts (allowing water, salt, tea, coffee, and a magnesium supplement) during chemoradiation followed by a 5-day fast during each adjuvant chemotherapy cycle, with a time-restricted modified ketogenic diet

role_evidence.quote: Concurrent chemoradiation - Radiation (60-Gy in 30 fractions over 6 weeks) with daily oral temozolomide.
Adjuvant chemotherapy - Daily oral temozolomide (5 days per 4-week cycle, starting 4 weeks after completion of chemoradiation, with at least 6 cycles intended).

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, standard Stupp chemoradiation backbone
arms: Standard treatment in conjunction with MTP

coder_notes: Phase NA dietary intervention (fasting + ketogenic diet) on top of Stupp; diet is an excluded intervention type and not a drug, so no pharmacological candidate. Temozolomide listed as soc_backbone because every patient receives it per the arm description (not a separate registered intervention). Magnesium supplement and multivitamin allowed during fasting are supplements mentioned in passing, not listed. Blood glucose-to-ketone ratio is a diet-adherence measure, not drug target engagement.
